name: the 0.36.1-beta.1 notes, in file order
markdown:
- Fixed: "Where is my code?" opens the gallery on the live site again. (#206)
- Fixed: the Forge 1.21.11 build can no longer ship an empty JAR.
- Changed: the mod's chat and error messages are now in English; the menus stay translated in every language. (#207)
- Changed: every supported version (Minecraft 1.18.2 to 1.21.11 with NeoForge, Fabric or Forge) is built and tested in game from a single build matrix before release.
- Changed: more in-game capture tests (Forge and Fabric 1.20.1, Forge 1.21.11).
